rules.s4: a band comes from measured bounds, a same-class analogue, or the reaction-class distribution of measured constants; a search bound is never a band; with no class, the output is refused (sec. 7 S4, 066684b7)
rules.edge_95: a bound's 95 % edge: 1.96 x the quadrature of the reported noise, the within-lab between-paper and assay spreads and the between-lab term (the lane's, S2 (b)); undefined for a lane without one
rules.transport: a bound at temperature T is carried to the reference temperature over the whole Ea band of the coordinate's class, at its loose edge (k and Ea are sampled jointly)
rules.reader: every source is this record's first reading of the dossier unless a verification file or register records a second reader; every proposed band needs a second reader (S1) before an S4 case applies it
